context: Morning office logistics. Laura is organizing R. John's schedule and is eager to please.

nodes.text: Good morning, Mr. John! I've organized your schedule for the debate prep. Everything is ready in Conference Room B.

moodVariations.Stressed: Morning, Mr. John. Your schedule is... it's a lot today. Debate prep is in Conference Room B.
moodVariations.Relaxed: Good morning! You're going to do great at the debate. I've got everything organized for you.
moodVariations.Neutral: Good morning, Mr. John. I've organized your schedule for the debate prep. Everything is ready in Conference Room B.

publicOptions.text: Excellent work, Laura. Thank you for staying on top of this.
You remind me of how dedicated Margaret was. She would have loved working with you.
Just make sure there are no conflicts. I can't be late.
You're always so cheerful in the morning. It's refreshing, Laura.
What's on the agenda after the debate prep?

privateThoughts.text: She's so eager to please. That innocent look... Maybe I should take advantage.
She's young and naive. Easy to manipulate if I need a loyal assistant.
Her enthusiasm is... nice. Reminds me I'm still alive. Still desirable.
Keep her happy and she'll work double time. Worth the flattery.
Just get to the point, Laura. I have a debate to prepare for.

nodes.text: Alright, Mr. John. I'll see you in the conference room at 10. Good luck with the debate prep!

moodVariations.Relaxed: See you at 10! You're going to do great!
moodVariations.Neutral: I'll see you in the conference room at 10. Good luck with the debate prep.

publicOptions.text: Thanks, Laura. I'll see you there.
